BriefDiagnosis.$comment: BriefDiagnosis.v1 — CMO step 1-6. Server checks: every KnowledgeRef exists and is approved; recommended_playbooks exist in registry.

WorkPlan.$comment: WorkPlan.v1 — CMO step 7-9. Server checks (semantic): playbook exists in registry and is not program@*; brief_fields validate against that playbook's brief schema; depends_on references existing ids; graph is acyclic; owner_gates.after references existing ids.

KnowledgeCandidate.$comment: KnowledgeCandidate.v1 — produced by research; stored as office.knowledge_docs status=draft; never reaches worker_context until owner approves.

FactReport.$comment: FactReport.v1 — Fact Gate. Semantic (server): verdict=pass iff blocking_claims empty; every blocking id exists in claims; contradicted => verdict fail; all KnowledgeRef approved and not expired.

ChallengeReport.$comment: ChallengeReport.v1 — recommends, never blocks. Semantic (server): every concept_id exists in subject; if any verdict=weak then stronger_alternative must be non-null.

DecisionMemo.$comment: DecisionMemo.v1 — CMO step 12: owner decision in 5 minutes. Semantic (server): recommendation.option_id exists in options.

BrainstormSession.$comment: BrainstormSession.v1 — created by owner or CMO. Server enforces: independent phase TaskEnvelopes contain no other participant turns; max_rounds; distinct executor_id per participant label.

BrainstormTurn.$comment: BrainstormTurn.v1 — one participant contribution. Semantic (server): responds_to/counterarguments reference turns of previous phases only.

BrainstormDecision.$comment: BrainstormDecision.v1 — synthesis. Disagreements are preserved, never averaged away.
